seo.title: Island View Park — Lake Texoma's Most Popular Beach · Day Passes, Shelters & Kayak Rentals
seo.description: A sandy beach on Lake Texoma open 9am to sunset year-round, 90 minutes from Dallas. $7 day passes (kids 7 & under free), covered shelters, kayak and paddleboard rentals, volleyball and outdoor showers. Buy your pass on texomadestinations.com.

home.heroKicker: The Most Fun place on Lake Texoma
home.heroTitle: The beach day that's closer than you think.
home.heroSubtitle: Lake Texoma's most popular sandy beach, open every day from 9am to sunset. Seven bucks gets you in. Kids seven and under are free.

intro.title: Sand, shade and a whole lake to look at
body: Island View is the day-trip beach for North Texas. Ninety minutes from Dallas you're on real sand with a swim area, picnic tables under the trees, covered shelters with grills, a volleyball court, outdoor showers and changing rooms, and a store for the things you forgot. Kayaks and paddleboards rent by the hour right off the beach.
It's also a birder's secret: the shoreline and coves here see hundreds of species through the year, and eagles in winter. Come early on summer weekends — the best shade goes first.

features.title: Day passes
features.body: $7 per person; kids seven and under are free. Buy online before you leave home and skip the line at the gate. TAP members get in free all year.

features.title: Covered shelters
features.body: Reserve a covered shelter with a picnic table for 6–10 and a charcoal grill for $40 a day — the move for birthdays and family cookouts. Reservation only; they sell out on holiday weekends.

features.title: Kayaks & paddleboards
features.body: Singles $25 an hour, doubles $40, paddleboards $25. Paddle the calm cove and around the point. Guided paddles for groups run about 90 minutes; solo paddlers must be 8 or older.

features.title: Picnics on the sand
features.body: Let us set the scene: a styled beach picnic for two with florals and an umbrella, or a boat ride to a private island picnic with Fastrac.

features.title: Group beach days
features.body: Company outings, youth groups and reunions get group pricing, shelter blocks, catering options and boat rentals through Texoma Destinations' events team.

features.title: Free with TAP
features.body: A TAP membership from $99 a year covers free day use for two (or four) at Island View and Paradise, free boat-ramp access at Lighthouse and Paradise, and discounts across the lake.

stay.subtitle: What's here, what it costs and how to make the most of it.

sections.title: The beach & swim area
body: A wide sandy beach with a gradual entry, picnic tables under mature trees, a volleyball court, outdoor showers and changing rooms. There is no lifeguard and no designated swim area — swim at your own risk and keep an eye on the kids. Glass containers stay in the car.

sections.title: Covered shelters
body: Shelters seat 6–10 at a picnic table with a charcoal grill under a roof — reserve one for $40 a day and it's yours from open to close. TAP Adventurer members get $5 off; Navigator members get weekday shelters free.

sections.title: Kayaks, paddleboards & guided paddles
body: Single kayaks are $25 an hour, doubles $40, stand-up paddleboards $25. Life jackets are included and required. Guided paddles for up to six run about 90 minutes and are a favorite for groups and first-timers.

sections.title: Picnics, groups & boat days
body: Texoma Destinations' events team styles beach picnics for two, arranges group pricing and catering for outings, and can add a Fastrac boat ride or water-taxi trip to the islands from right here.

plan.title: Getting to Island View
plan.subtitle: 87426 Preston Bend Road, Pottsboro — on the Preston Peninsula just up the road from Lighthouse Resort.

arrival.title: Hours & the gate
body: Open 9am to sunset every day of the year. The gate closes 30 minutes after sunset — please be packed and rolling by then. Show your online pass or pay at the gate; shelters are reservation-only, so book ahead.
Once you're inside, there are no refunds for weather. Check the forecast, bring shade, and remember the lake is usually calmest in the morning.

directions: From Pottsboro take SH 289 north toward Lighthouse Resort; turn onto Preston Bend Road and follow signs to Island View.
About 90 minutes from downtown Dallas via US-75.
Parking is in designated areas only — arrive early on summer weekends.
Coming by boat? Fastrac's water taxi stops at Island View.
